question: Brij Bhushan Kabra is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guitar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brij Bhushan Kabra** is associated with the **guitar.**
 
• He was one of the pioneers of Indian classical guitar and introduced the instrument to** Indian classical music.**
 
• He also created a new style of **playing the guitar** which involved playing with a slide, similar to the technique used in** playing the Indian instrument, the sitar.**
 
• Kabra's most famous album is **"Call of the Valley"** which he recorded with** Pandit Shivkumar Sharma** and **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shehnai** is a **wind instrument** commonly used in **North Indian classical music**.
 
• **Violin** is a string instrument commonly used in **Western classical music.**
 
• The** sound of a flute** is produced by the** movement of air **across an opening, making it a** reedless or aerophone** wind instrument.
 
• **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia **is a renowned** flute player **in Indian classical music.
